children: Motilal Oswal's research report on TATA Motors

Tata Motors’ (TMCV) 2QFY27 PAT at INR19.7b was 17% above our est. due to strong margin performance and higher other income due to strong FCF generation. Given the better-than-expected margin performance in 2Q, we raise our earnings estimates by 9% for FY27, while keeping our FY28 numbers broadly intact. We now model TMCV to post a CAGR of 11%/8%/11% in revenue/ EBITDA/PAT over FY26-28E. The stock appears fairly valued at 20.8x FY27E and 18.1x FY28E EPS. We reiterate our Neutral rating with a TP of INR416, valuing the core business at 12x FY28E EV/EBITDA and adding INR12 per share for its stake in Tata Capital. We have not integrated the Iveco financials into our numbers yet, nor have we ascribed a valuation for the same in our SOTP.
